summary: Iter7 — Validated (a) ITER6 bug fixes (stat-tour-days-ytd no trailing dash + zero React key-spread warnings on /my-leaves), and (b) NEW /api/leaves/event-conflicts endpoint with frontend EventConflictNotice wired into both /my-leaves Apply form and /admin/leaves Approvals detail row. Backend: 221/221 pytest pass (213 prior + 8 new iter7). Frontend: all 8 StatCard testids resolve, ZERO React 'key prop' warnings on /my-leaves load. EventConflictNotice renders correctly: amber tone with 'Regatta overlap · N regattas during this window' summary when only regattas overlap, expanded details show camps + regattas sections, admin Approvals detail row shows it full-width below Overlap+Balance grid (verified — first expanded row shows 'Regatta overlap · 2 regattas during this window' with 40th International Hyderabad Sailing Week + Cadet Championship chips).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/leaves/event-conflicts (leaves.py:156–217) cleanly implements the spec: camps gated by (institution match) AND (member_ids empty OR target in roster), regattas org-wide. Match label correctly distinguishes 'roster' vs 'institution'. Authorization guard at line 178-180 correctly returns 403 when a non-admin asks for someone else's user_id; no auth → 401 from get_current_user dependency. MongoDB overlap query uses standard inverse-overlap formula (start<=end_date AND end>=start_date) — same pattern as the existing /leaves/overlap, good consistency.

MyLeaves.jsx line 171 destructures `{ key, ...rest }` before spread — clean fix for the React key-via-spread warning. Line 191 regex now appends `.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')` to strip trailing/leading dashes from the auto-generated testid — fixes 'Tour days (YTD)' → 'stat-tour-days-ytd' correctly without affecting the other 7 tiles. Future-proofs labels that end with non-alpha chars.

EventConflictNotice.jsx is a clean reusable component: amber palette for regatta-only, red palette when camps present, capped at 8 visible chips with overflow, suppressed when both arrays empty. Multi-pick admin 'Apply on behalf' correctly suppresses the notice since roster differs across members. Solid abstraction mirroring OverlapNotice's collapsible pattern.
